statement: For each of the eight actual F19 cross divisors v_u=epsilon a, the original rank-eleven source acts transitively on the entire discrete divisor-coset space and on its full profinite completion. The projection of the actual centralizer of each selected primitive cross meridian contains its corresponding full divisor subgroup. Consequently the closed normal closure of K+ inside D+ is all of D+, and the actual maps K+ -> D+ abelianization and K+ -> the maximal pronilpotent quotient of D+ are surjective. Every continuous finite nilpotent quotient of D+ has equal images on K+ and D+. The full subgroup equality K+=D+ and the original residual source-membership equation remain unresolved.
